subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The cafeteria manager explained that the goal was not shame.”?
options: A small sign appeared outside a breakfast shop: "Students who forgot breakfast may take one rice ball for free."
If students saw how much food was thrown away, they might take only what they could finish.
Students could see a screen near the office showing how much electricity the panels produced each day.
They saw it as a message: what people throw away does not always stay where they leave it.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The cafeteria manager explained that the goal was not shame. If students saw how much food was thrown away, they might take only what…」，答案為「If students saw how much food was thrown away, they might take only what they could finish.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「If students saw how much food was thrown away, they might take only what they could finish.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
